## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. For UI changes, include sanitized
screenshots when useful. State any hardware/server paths that remain untested.

- [ ] Relevant build/tests pass; skipped cases are explained.
- [ ] User/reference docs and Unreleased notes reflect behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, token-bearing URLs, personal server data, or generated builds are included.
- [ ] New code/assets can be contributed under the project license; third-party notices are retained.
